# ZHAO Xuecen Jack Portfolio

ZHAO Xuecen Jack is a Robotics Systems Engineer at Stairio Limited, Hong Kong, and a Hong Kong Polytechnic University mechanical engineering graduate. His work covers robotics, mechatronics, CAD and engineering simulation (ANSYS CFD, Isaac Sim), AI-assisted engineering, embedded systems, and full-stack technical project delivery.

This site is a public engineering portfolio for recruiters, collaborators, professors, and AI/search agents evaluating Jack's hands-on project experience. Key evidence includes a fuel-cell robot car, a handrail-riding stairwell inspection robot and its simulator, robot competitions, AI education tools, agentic operations software, and CAD product work.

## Featured Projects

- Vandi - Fuel-Cell-Powered Robot Car (Final Year Project, 2025 - 2026; three-person team. Jack's part: mechanical design, AI training, simulation, control algorithms and the control front end. Teammates did the fuel chemistry and the electrical and PCB/BMS design): https://zhao255.github.io/projects/fuel-cell-car/
- Stairio robotics systems engineering work (handrail-riding stairwell inspection robot): https://zhao255.github.io/experience/stairio/
- Stairio Simulator: testing a handrail inspection robot without the stairwell, with the Unreal software twin, Stair Mapper rail reconstruction and camera-planning studies: https://zhao255.github.io/projects/stairio-simulator/
- Stairio HR hiring system: https://zhao255.github.io/projects/stairio-hr/
- Interactive Math Content Generation Platform: https://zhao255.github.io/projects/interactive-math/
- Lobby OpenClaw AI operations system: https://zhao255.github.io/projects/lobby-openclaw/
- Car Spoiler Operations, with an interactive original-CAD mechanism and actuator-load study: https://zhao255.github.io/projects/car-spoiler-ops/
- Auto Sheet & Auto Class, with an interactive course planner and calendar export: https://zhao255.github.io/projects/ai-automation/
- Robot Basketball Competition (team leader; the team won first place in the inter-departmental competition between EEE and ME, IC382, 2024–25): https://zhao255.github.io/projects/robot-basketball/
- 5-DOF Robot Arm FK / IK Study: https://zhao255.github.io/projects/robot-arm-fk-ik/
- Smart Navigational Cane (concept proposal): https://zhao255.github.io/projects/smart-cane/
